WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) AS min_sk,
           MAX(d_date_sk) AS max_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
),
daily AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(web_tot) AS web_tot,
           MAX(web_present) AS web_present,
           SUM(store_tot) AS store_tot,
           MAX(store_present) AS store_present
    FROM (
        SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
               dd.d_date AS d_date,
               SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS web_tot,
               1 AS web_present,
               CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS store_tot,
               CAST(NULL AS integer) AS store_present
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_sk FROM date_range) AND (SELECT max_sk FROM date_range)
          AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
        GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dd.d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
               dd.d_date AS d_date,
               CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS web_tot,
               CAST(NULL AS integer) AS web_present,
               SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS store_tot,
               1 AS store_present
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_sk FROM date_range) AND (SELECT max_sk FROM date_range)
          AND dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212+11
        GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dd.d_date
    ) u
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_tot,
           web_present,
           store_tot,
           store_present,
           SUM(web_tot) OVER w AS cume_web,
           SUM(store_tot) OVER w AS cume_store
    FROM daily
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           CASE WHEN web_present IS NOT NULL THEN cume_web ELSE NULL END AS web_sales,
           CASE WHEN store_present IS NOT NULL THEN cume_store ELSE NULL END AS store_sales,
           MAX(CASE WHEN web_present IS NOT NULL THEN cume_web END) OVER w AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(CASE WHEN store_present IS NOT NULL THEN cume_store END) OVER w AS store_cumulative
    FROM cumulative
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM ranked
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
